quotes.text: Seems updateMessageCount would be a better name
I would either call it shouldUpdateMessageCount or flip the meaning and call it skipUpdateMessageCount.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Use an action name such as updateMessageCount for the operation. Avoid a boolean variable with the same name as the function it controls; use a condition spelling such as shouldUpdateMessageCount or skipUpdateMessageCount when such a flag is needed. This comes from D210487. The final patch eliminated that flag, so the suggested names are a review naming recommendation rather than examples of landed variables. Scope to local JS readability; this batch does not establish global prefix mandates.
title: Name actions as verbs and booleans as conditions in touched JS
